purpose: Define reusable responsive layout primitives for Expose surfaces so desktop/mobile adaptation is driven by declared layout semantics rather than duplicated page-specific CSS structures.

topics.name: Responsive Layout Primitives
topics.purpose: Define reusable responsive layout primitives for Expose surfaces so desktop/mobile adaptation is driven by declared layout semantics rather than duplicated page-specific CSS structures.

semantics.responsive_rule: Layout behavior across viewport/container sizes is explicit.
semantics.container_rule: Components may respond to parent/container constraints where supported.
semantics.order_rule: Visual rearrangement does not alter semantic or execution order unless the owning semantic explicitly declares it.
semantics.accessibility_rule: Responsive changes preserve meaningful reading/focus order.
semantics.composition_rule: Pages/MetaModules compose layout primitives with content primitives.
semantics.style_rule: Dimensions/gaps/breakpoints reference canonical style/config tokens where shared.

invariants.rule: Web Base, style, assets and responsive layout define reusable presentation primitives only; they do not become semantic or runtime authority.

hard_gates.condition: visual order changes semantic execution order
module implements private duplicate layout foundation without reason
breakpoint meaning inferred from DOM position only

references.purpose: Responsive layout extends shared Web Base.
Shared layout values use canonical style tokens.
